name: m4t2
description: Companies week (SPEC §2.7 / issue #57): a six-Pop village charters 'Aurora Guild' (focus food) absorbing two kitchens and a lumber camp as seed Branches. Branch output routes a 20% market-value share into the virtual treasury at exact integer milli-credits — meal cycles complete on exact 300-tick beats (value 10 × 20% ⇒ 2000 milli each) while the physical units still stockpile normally; every wood delivery lands at the branch camp (the world's ONLY drop-off) accruing 200 milli per unit. Branch foremen are appointed EXCLUSIVELY by the company staffing pass from its own rated Pops (officers hold the posts; direct-order-locked gatherers are untouchable). Mid-run the company FREEZES for 300 ticks: staffing churn halts yet production and treasury accrual continue uninterrupted, then thaw restores churn. Fixture pins milestone digests every 150th tick plus a legible treasury/staffing/frozen trace, the §2.7 acceptance beats (exact charter→production→treasury routing, exclusive staffing, freeze semantics), and doubles as the extended double-run determinism canary.
